chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ali ibn Ahmad ibn Asheym, who said:

I asked him (peace be upon him) about a man whose wife had become pure from her menstruation, so he said, 'So-and-so woman is divorced,' and a group was listening to his speech, and he did not tell them, 'Bear witness.' Has the divorce taken effect upon her? He said, 'Yes, it is a witnessing; otherwise, would she be left hanging (in uncertainty)?'
ai.seo_question: Does a divorce take effect if declared in front of listeners without explicitly asking them to witness?
ai.summary: In this narration from *Al-Kafi*, the Imam clarifies that explicit invocation of witnesses is not a strict condition for the validity of *talaq*; rather, the mere presence and auditory perception of a competent group suffice to establish the legal fact. This ruling prevents the marital status from remaining in a state of *mu'allaqah* (suspension/uncertainty), ensuring legal clarity for the wife. It reflects the Shia juristic principle that the essence of witnessing lies in the actual perception of the event by reliable observers, rather than in formal ceremonial declarations.

en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, form Ali Bin Ahmad Bin Asheym who said,

‘I asked him<sup>asws</sup> about a man whose wife was pure from her menstruation, so he said, ‘So and so woman is divorced, and a group was listening his speech, and he did not tell them, ‘Bear witness’, has his divorced occurred upon her?’ He said, ‘Yes, it is a witnessing (otherwise) she would be left hanging’.
en.sarwar: 2. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ali Ahmad ibn ‘Ushaym who has said the following: “

I once asked him (the Imam), ‘Alayhi al-Salam, about the case of a man whose wife becomes clean of Hayd (menses) and he says, ‘So and so is ‘Taliq’ (let go, divorced) and a people hears his statement but he does not say, “Bear witness”; if divorce takes place or not. He (the Imam) said, ‘Yes, it is bearing witness. Can she be left in suspense?”’
